**Gross margin calculation for FY2024:**

According to Microsoft's FY2024 10-K, revenue for fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 was $245,122 million and cost of revenue was $74,114 million [DOC-1].

- Gross profit = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin % = $171,008M / $245,122M = **69.76%**

Both figures (revenue and cost of revenue) are from the same fiscal year and reporting basis within the same 10-K, so this is a directly comparable, internally consistent calculation.

ANSWER: Gross profit of approximately $171,008 million, representing a gross margin of approximately 69.8% of revenue ($245,122M revenue − $74,114M cost of revenue).
